contentHtml:
Ahmedabad: Zydus Lifesciences Limited has disclosed that its wholly owned subsidiary, Zydus Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. (ZPUI), has entered into a Settlement Agreement with a putative class of Indirect Reseller Plaintiffs to resolve certain litigation matters related to generic pharmaceutical pricing.
